description.narrative: The project is implemented in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The main outcome area it contributes to is equality and workers' rights. The main right holders are workers, especially in the private sector. Through mobilising, trainings and free legal advise, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Center for Civic Cooperation, ABF Jnkping and ABF Kronoberg, branches of the Workers' Education Association (ABF) and the Palme Center. Center for Civic Cooperation promotes citizen activism and functions as a resource organisation for the trade union movement in south-western Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH). The branches of ABF are centres for popular education and their project leaders have particular competence in labour unionism.Project ObjectiveThe overall objective is to improve trade union capacities to be effective service providers for workers and equal partners in the process of creation and implementation of labour policies and practices in south-west Bosnia and Herzegovina and the country as a whole.Actor groupsRightholders: Workers from Cantons 1, 7, 8 and 10 and across the country High school students as future workers. Actors in cooperation: Trade unions and NGOs from south-western BiH (27 municipalities from Cantons 1, 7, 8 and 10 and from other parts of country) through the Workers' Rights Coalition. BiH industrial and umbrella trade unions who have a vested interest in motivating workers to establish trade unions especially in the private sector in our target cantons. Employers associations at all levels Office of the Human Rights Ombudsman BH NGOs who are focused on raising awareness of labour rights and the social rights associated with employment and unemployment Progressive politicians Local and national media Decision-makers: Government bodies (ministries, inspectorates, courts, taxation offices, pension and health funds) responsible for adoption, implementation and monitoring implementation of legislation as well as documenting and sanctioning violations, with whom the Coalition will establish communication and cooperation and attempt to institutionalise an effective dialogue.
